data.narrative:
Texture Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Sanjiv Sanghavi, Victor Quinn, and Nicholas Brown. The company has raised $24.3M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of 8 private peers in Climate & Energy—including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix—plus one public comparable (Linamar, ticker LNZA).

Stage-progression analysis is applicable here. Using total capital raised ($24.3M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series A-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.0x yields an implied valuation of $49M. A peer-median approach cannot be reliably applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy filterset; while 8 same-sector peers exist, none meet the thresholds for stage and tier similarity needed to generate three or more datapoints.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $41M to $56M, with a median estimate of $49M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty, principally stemming from the absence of tightly matched private peer valuations at Series A. Additional visibility into burn rate, revenue (if any), and customer traction would sharpen the estimate. The wide range ($41M–$56M) should be treated as exploratory pending access to narrower comparable transactions or operating metrics.
